# EcoSapien — Paper, thread, and wire

> Artist portfolio across watercolour, charcoal, embroidery and filigree-wire jewellery.

- [Portfolio](https://www.ecosapien.de/): selected work and practice introduction.
- [Art application](https://www.ecosapien.de/applications.html): 24 European art study routes with fees, languages, portfolio requirements and official admissions links. Research snapshot checked 1 October 2026; unconfirmed fees and dates are marked.
- [All applications](https://www.ecosapien.de/all-applications.html): German public-university master's routes reviewed for a Home Science / interior design background. Snapshot checked 4 October 2026. Eligibility is conditional; no suitable open winter 2026/27 route was verified for the stated profile. Future annual deadlines are projections unless marked published. Private tracking is on the separate Databases page.
- [Master's comparison CSV](https://www.ecosapien.de/all-applications.csv): the full comparison, including clearly labelled routes with known barriers.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/eco-sapien/site): static GitHub Pages website.

The current gallery identifies its collections as being prepared; artwork photographs have not yet been added. Do not infer artworks or exhibition history from these collection placeholders.

- [Databases](https://www.ecosapien.de/databases.html): combined art and master’s dashboard with deadlines, document-readiness charts, application stages and shared Supabase progress and private document uploads/downloads for invited members. Personal progress is never published to GitHub.
